_comment: Local/demo realm only. Every credential in this file is a throwaway value meant to be read in a repository — see docker-compose.yml for the same note. Nothing here is used, or usable, outside a developer's own machine.

realm.name: ADJUSTER
realm.description: Opens and works claims: create, change status, assign.

realm.name: SUPERVISOR
realm.description: Everything ADJUSTER can do, plus the audit trail and actuator write/read operations gated to SUPERVISOR in SecurityConfig.

realm.name: READONLY
realm.description: Read-only access to claims, policies and directory endpoints. Cannot change a claim's status (ClaimController#changeStatus requires ADJUSTER).

realm.name: MONITORING
realm.description: Scrape access to /actuator/prometheus only — see SecurityConfig, which maps this to hasRole('MONITORING').

clients.name: HELIX application
clients.description: Public client used by the Angular SPA and by curl/Postman for local testing. Public because it is a browser/CLI client with no secret to protect — the resource server never trusts the client, only the signed token.

users._comment: One demo account carrying every role so a reviewer can exercise the whole API without juggling logins — the same trade-off local-noauth makes, just via a real token instead of a permissive filter chain.
Second account with only READONLY, so 403 on a write endpoint is easy to demonstrate against a real token.
